adv-ca-kenya.last_note: No change to the Kenya advisory: exercise a high degree of caution; avoid all travel to Mandera, Wajir, Garissa and Lamu; last updated 9 Sep 2026. DIARISED ITEM, NOW FIVE DAYS OUT: Canada's temporary Ebola border measures still expire 28 September 2026 23:59 EDT. NO successor, replacement or further-extension notice published as at this morning. The operative instrument remains the 30-day extension announced by PHAC on 28 August 2026: foreign nationals who visited the DRC in the previous 21 days barred; symptomatic citizens/PRs isolated, asymptomatic ones assessed and quarantined 21 days; immigration documents suspended for residents of DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, with IRCC processing but not finalising affected applications. P198 stays OPEN.

adv-fr-kenya.last_note: No change. Last update remains 18 September 2026. Kenya-Somalia border zone formally deconseille to 100km inland — still the widest of the five advisories tracked.
